title: Endive Spear Micro Salads - Toasted Quinoa, Corn, Ricotta Micro Salad

ingredientSections.heading: Dijon Dressing
items: Ground salt and pepper to taste

methodSections.heading: Toasted Quinoa
steps: Rinse the quinoa until the water runs clear and then place in a saucepan. Cook over a medium heat while stirring continuously. It will dry and then begin to stick before beginning to toast to a light gold colour and smell toasted.
Add the water and salt, increase the heat and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and allow all the water to absorb, roughly 30 minutes.

methodSections.heading: Dijon Dressing
steps: Whisk all of the ingredients together except the olive oil and salt and pepper. Slowly add the olive oil bit by bit while continuing to whisk. Season to taste.

methodSections.heading: Assembly
steps: Cook and blacken the cob on a BBQ or griddle. Remove the corn from the cob and place in a bowl with the diced avocados, lemon juice and toasted quinoa. Season lightly to taste.

Arrange the endive spears so they are ready to fill. Place a spoonful of the filling mixture onto each endive spear along with a sprinkle of the crumbled ricotta and dressing. Serve with the preserve on the side.
